ns2:section.sectionText: New freshmen in Engineering or Engineering-rate majors must enroll in lecture EL1 or EL2. Continuing students in Engineering who register after May 29, 2020, should e-mail mathadvising@illinois.edu <mailto:mathadvising@illinois.edu> with name, UIN, and continuing status to receive an override.
